newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly molasses report - July 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly molasses report - July 14.

text.p: Prices on sugarcane molasses were unchanged in the week ended July 12, USDA Market News said in their weekly National Molasses report. Molasses supplies are moderate and demand is light. Domestic molasses usage remains light to moderate.

Lower prices for corn, light feedlot demand and good grazing in many areas continue to pressure molasses prices. Molasses prices were again supported by good dairy demand on the West Coast and the upper midwest portions of the country, according to USDA.
